paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Legal & Compliance Evaluator position at LegalTrustAI. The opportunity to utilize my international legal expertise in a remote role aligns perfectly with my career goals.

With an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and practical experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, I am confident that my skills will be highly beneficial to your team. At Poise Legal in India, I managed the full lifecycle of 5-7 commercial agreements per month while conducting regulatory and company law research.

My recent language internship at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu has provided me with direct exposure to Finnish legal practice and procedures, further enhancing my ability to integrate international legal expertise with local systems. I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised).

I am particularly drawn to LegalTrustAI's innovative approach to combining legal expertise with cutting-edge technology. I believe that my strong research, analytical, and communication skills will enable me to contribute effectively to your team.
Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your organization.
